answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 46443 Country: Bangladesh Title: Selling of bidati books Question: My father runs a business in Dhaka, Bangladesh and we sell books like Maksudul Momineen, Niyamul Quran, Sirajus Saleqin etc. Most of the authentic Hanafi scholars of Bangladesh have given the fatwa that these books are full of bida’h. So is it allowed for us to sell them? Will the income earned from these bida’ati books be halal? Please clarify. Answer ID: 46443 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1188/1184/M=10/1434) As per Hadith, bida’h is deviation. Hence it is helping in sin to sell and publish the books which deal with bida’h; hence you should avoid it. The income which is received through it is not completely pure and free of doubt. ما قامت المعصية بعينه يكره بيعه تحريماً وإلا فتنزيهاً (در مختار مع الرد 9/509 زكريا) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
